title: Recycle Rush: Restore Verdale
description: Restore Verdale’s school and market with animated Circuit and Grime, hands-on recovery activities, saved community decisions, project choices and two energy-powered showdowns. Ten untimed story missions with distinct original music and saved progress sit alongside the preserved 20-mission arcade campaign.

controls.action: Inspect, complete a hands-on activity when needed, then select or drag to the accepted route.

controls.key: Arcade: tap or drag item to bin
controls.action: Choose its material destination. A/D or arrows selects a bin; Enter routes the lowest item.
Clear arcade hazards / activate the collected arcade power-up.
Pause, adjust music and effects, retry the current story area or return to the map.
